# Sampling and Outliers

```{r, 0_libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
library(haven)

library(DT)
library(huxtable)
library(lmtest)

```

```{r, 0_import_data}

# Load data civ88-08_nutri.dta and civ88-08_mortality.dta
civ_87_08 <- read_dta(here::here("measurement_p3/civ_87_08.dta"))
```

```{r, 1_conspc_summary}
#| label: tbl-conspc_summary

# compute consumption per capita
civ_87_08 <- civ_87_08 %>%
  mutate(conspc_com = (exp_food + exp_othr) / hhsize)

# create a table to compare conspc and conspc_compute by year. Estimate the unweighted mean, weighted mean, min, max, standard deviation, median, number of observations, and number of missing values for conspc and conspc_compute by year.
civ_87_08 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(conspc_com),
      list(
        Mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Min = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Max = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Std dev` = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Obs = ~sum(!is.na(.x)),
        `NAs` = ~sum(is.na(.x))
      ),
      .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -year,
    names_to = c("Variable", ".value"),
    names_sep = "__"
  ) %>%
  rename(Year = year) %>%
  kable(
    digits = 2,
    caption = "Summary statistics of consumption per capita computed."
  )
```

```{r, 1_filter_outliers}
# For each year, estimate the unweighted median and standard deviation of log(conspc), then exclude observations that are more than 3 standard deviations away from the median. Report the number of observations excluded for each year.
# civ_87_08 %>%
#   group_by(year) %>%
#   summarise(
#     Median = median(log(conspc), na.rm = TRUE),
#     SD = sd(log(conspc), na.rm = TRUE),
#     Lower_bound = Median - 3 * SD,
#     Upper_bound = Median + 3 * SD,
#     Excluded = sum(log(conspc) < Lower_bound | log(conspc) > Upper_bound, na.rm = TRUE),
#     .groups = "drop"
#   )

# Withdraw the excluded observations from the dataset
civ_87_08_cleaned <- civ_87_08 %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  filter(log(conspc) >= median(log(conspc), na.rm = TRUE) - 3 * sd(log(conspc), na.rm = TRUE) & log(conspc) <= median(log(conspc), na.rm = TRUE) + 3 * sd(log(conspc), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-conspc_summary_cleaned

civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    across(
      c(conspc),
      list(
        Mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Min = ~min(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Max = ~max(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        `Std dev` = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
        Obs = ~sum(!is.na(.x)),
        `NAs` = ~sum(is.na(.x))
      ),
      .names = "{.col}__{.fn}"
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(

  )
```

# Consumer Price Index (CPI) and Purchasing Power Parities (PPP)

**2.a**
```{r, 2_representative}
# 1. Dummy identifying representative households
civ_87_08_cleaned <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  mutate(is_representative = ifelse(hhsize == 4 & femalehead == 0 & (work_farmer == 1 | work_selfem == 1), 1, 0),
         food_share = exp_food / constot,
         other_share = exp_othr / constot,
         exp_weight = hhsize * weight * conspc
         )

model_f_share <- lm(food_share ~ 0 + factor(year):factor(north), data = civ_87_08_cleaned %>% filter(is_representative == 1), weights = exp_weight)
model_o_share <- lm(other_share ~ 0 + factor(year):factor(north), data = civ_87_08_cleaned %>% filter(is_representative == 1), weights = exp_weight)

```


```{r, 2_cpi}
# 1. Prepare data and filter representative households
rep_data <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    is_representative = ifelse(hhsize == 4 & femalehead == 0 & (work_farmer == 1 | work_selfem == 1), 1, 0),
    food_share  = exp_food / constot,
    other_share = exp_othr / constot,
    exp_weight  = hhsize * weight * conspc
  ) %>%
  filter(is_representative == 1)

# 2. Estimate 6 separate models (one per share type and year)
f_87 <- lm(food_share  ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(rep_data, year == 1987), weights = exp_weight)
f_98 <- lm(food_share  ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(rep_data, year == 1998), weights = exp_weight)
f_08 <- lm(food_share  ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(rep_data, year == 2008), weights = exp_weight)

o_87 <- lm(other_share ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(rep_data, year == 1987), weights = exp_weight)
o_98 <- lm(other_share ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(rep_data, year == 1998), weights = exp_weight)
o_08 <- lm(other_share ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(rep_data, year == 2008), weights = exp_weight)

# 3. Combine into a single 6-column, 2-row huxreg table
tab_shares <- huxreg(
  "1987" = f_87, "1998" = f_98, "2008" = f_08,
  "1987" = o_87, "1998" = o_98, "2008" = o_08,
  coefs = c(
    "North" = "factor(north)1",
    "South" = "factor(north)0"
  ),
  error_format = "({std.error})",
  error_pos = "below",
  align = "c",
  statistics = c(N = "nobs", R2 = "r.squared"),
  stars = c(`***` = 0.01, `**` = 0.05, `*` = 0.1),
  note = "Significance: {stars}"
)

# 4. Add spanning group headers ("Food" and "Non-food") above the year headers
tab_shares <- tab_shares %>%
  insert_row("", "Food", "", "", "Non-food", "", "", after = 0) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 2:4) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 5:7) %>%
  set_align(1, 2:7, "center") %>%
  set_bold(1, 2:7, TRUE) %>%
  set_bottom_border(1, 2:4, 0.4) %>%
  set_bottom_border(1, 5:7, 0.4) %>%
  set_caption("Budget Shares in Cote d'Ivoire from 1987 to 2008")


tab_shares <- set_label(tab_shares, "tbl-food_shares")
tab_shares <- set_all_padding(tab_shares, 1.5)

tab_shares
```

**2.b**
```{r 3_1_laspeyres_paasche}
# 1. Compute Laspeyres and Paasche CPI on the 1987 = 100 scale (shares already in 0-1)
civ_87_08_cleaned <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  group_by(north) %>%
  mutate(
    p_food_87 = first(avprice_food[year == 1987]),
    p_othr_87 = first(avprice_othr[year == 1987]),
    s_food_87 = first(bdgshr_food[year == 1987]),
    s_othr_87 = first(bdgshr_othr[year == 1987]),
    
    # Laspeyres CPI (Base 1987 = 100)
    cpi_laspeyres = (s_food_87 * (avprice_food / p_food_87) +
                           s_othr_87 * (avprice_othr / p_othr_87)),
    
    # Paasche CPI (Base 1987 = 100, harmonic mean)
    cpi_paasche = (bdgshr_food * (p_food_87 / avprice_food) +
                           bdgshr_othr * (p_othr_87 / avprice_othr))
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Estimate year-specific level models (Cols 1-6)
lasp_87 <- lm(cpi_laspeyres ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, year == 1987))
lasp_98 <- lm(cpi_laspeyres ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, year == 1998))
lasp_08 <- lm(cpi_laspeyres ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, year == 2008))

paas_87 <- lm(cpi_paasche ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, year == 1987))
paas_98 <- lm(cpi_paasche ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, year == 1998))
paas_08 <- lm(cpi_paasche ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, year == 2008))

# 3. Stack dataset to create the pooled sample and estimate pooled OLS models (Cols 7-9)
pooled_cpi <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  select(hhid, year, north, cpi_laspeyres, cpi_paasche) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(cpi_laspeyres, cpi_paasche),
    names_to = "index_type",
    values_to = "cpi_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(is_laspeyres = ifelse(index_type == "cpi_laspeyres", 1, 0))

pool_87 <- lm(cpi_value ~ 0 + factor(north) + factor(north):is_laspeyres, data = filter(pooled_cpi, year == 1987))
pool_98 <- lm(cpi_value ~ 0 + factor(north) + factor(north):is_laspeyres, data = filter(pooled_cpi, year == 1998))
pool_08 <- lm(cpi_value ~ 0 + factor(north) + factor(north):is_laspeyres, data = filter(pooled_cpi, year == 2008))

# Extract standard OLS difference coefficients (L - P) and align row names
extract_diff <- function(mod) {
  ct <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  ct_diff <- ct[c("factor(north)1:is_laspeyres", "factor(north)0:is_laspeyres"), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(ct_diff) <- c("factor(north)1", "factor(north)0")
  class(ct_diff) <- "coeftest"
  ct_diff
}

diff_87 <- extract_diff(pool_87)
diff_98 <- extract_diff(pool_98)
diff_08 <- extract_diff(pool_08)

# 4. Build the 9-column, 2-row huxreg table
tab_cpi <- huxreg(
  "1987" = lasp_87, "1998" = lasp_98, "2008" = lasp_08,
  "1987" = paas_87, "1998" = paas_98, "2008" = paas_08,
  "1987" = diff_87, "1998" = diff_98, "2008" = diff_08,
  coefs = c(
    "North" = "factor(north)1",
    "South" = "factor(north)0"
  ),
  error_format = "",
  error_pos = "below",
  number_format = 2,
  statistics = c(N = "nobs"),
  stars = NULL,
  note = "Notes: Base year 1987 = 100. Differences (L - P) estimated via pooled OLS. Significance stars omitted since all estimates are highly significant."
)

# 5. Add spanning headers
tab_cpi <- tab_cpi %>%
  insert_row("", "Laspeyres CPI", "", "", "Paasche CPI", "", "", "Difference (L - P)", "", "", after = 0) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 2:4) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 5:7) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 8:10) %>%
  set_align(1, 2:10, "center") %>%
  set_bold(1, 2:10, TRUE) %>%
  set_bottom_border(1, 2:4, 0.4) %>%
  set_bottom_border(1, 5:7, 0.4) %>%
  set_bottom_border(1, 8:10, 0.4) %>%
  set_caption("Laspeyres and Paasche Consumer Price Indices by region and year")

tab_cpi <- set_label(tab_cpi, "tbl-cpi")
tab_cpi <- set_all_padding(tab_cpi, 1.5)

tab_cpi
```

**2.c** 
```{r 2_3_ppp}
# 1. Compute Laspeyres, Paasche, Fisher PPP (South = 1 each year), and L - P difference
civ_87_08_cleaned <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    s_food = bdgshr_food / 100,
    s_othr = bdgshr_othr / 100
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    # Reference region (South, north == 0) prices and budget shares in year t
    p_food_S = first(avprice_food[north == 0]),
    p_othr_S = first(avprice_othr[north == 0]),
    s_food_S = first(s_food[north == 0]),
    s_othr_S = first(s_othr[north == 0]),
    
    # Laspeyres PPP (South = 1)
    ppp_laspeyres = s_food_S * (avprice_food / p_food_S) +
                    s_othr_S * (avprice_othr / p_othr_S),
    
    # Paasche PPP (South = 1)
    ppp_paasche = 1 / (s_food * (p_food_S / avprice_food) +
                       s_othr * (p_othr_S / avprice_othr)),
    
    # Fisher PPP (geometric mean of Laspeyres and Paasche, South = 1)
    ppp_fisher = sqrt(ppp_laspeyres * ppp_paasche),
    
    # Difference between Laspeyres and Paasche PPP
    ppp_diff = ppp_laspeyres - ppp_paasche
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 2. Estimate via saturated OLS on Northern households (north == 1)
north_data <- filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, north == 1)

ols_ppp_L <- lm(ppp_laspeyres ~ 0 + factor(year), data = north_data)
ols_ppp_P <- lm(ppp_paasche   ~ 0 + factor(year), data = north_data)
ols_ppp_F <- lm(ppp_fisher    ~ 0 + factor(year), data = north_data)
ols_ppp_diff <- lm(ppp_diff      ~ 0 + factor(year), data = north_data)

# 3. Display in a clean 4-column huxreg table
outreg <- huxreg(
  "Laspeyres PPP" = ols_ppp_L,
  "Paasche PPP" = ols_ppp_P,
  "Fisher PPP" = ols_ppp_F,
  "Diff (L - P)" = ols_ppp_diff,
  coefs = c(
    "1987" = "factor(year)1987",
    "1998" = "factor(year)1998",
    "2008" = "factor(year)2008"
  ),
  number_format = 4,
  statistics = c(N = "nobs"),
  stars = NULL,
  note = "Notes: South = 1.0000 in each year. Diff (L - P) = Laspeyres PPP - Paasche PPP. Significance stars omitted since all estimates are highly significant."
) %>%
  set_label("tbl-ppp") %>%
  set_caption("North PPP with respect to the South region.") %>%
  set_all_padding(1.5)

outreg
```

**2.d**

```{r, 2_4_real_consumption}
deflators <- tibble(
  north = c(1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0),
  year  = c(1987, 1998, 2008, 1987, 1998, 2008),
  cpi_t3 = c(100.00, 180.00, 240.36, 100.00, 192.45, 255.73),
  ppp_t3 = c(72.91,  68.91,  66.39,  100.00, 100.00, 100.00)
)

civ_24 <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  left_join(deflators, by = c("north", "year")) %>%
  mutate(
    weight_pop  = hhsize * weight,
    conspc_1987 = conspc / ((cpi_t3 / 100) * (ppp_t3 / 100))
  )

# 2. Estimate mean consumption before (nominal) and after (real 1987 South PPP) via weighted OLS
nom_87  <- lm(conspc ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_24, year == 1987), weights = weight_pop)
nom_98  <- lm(conspc ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_24, year == 1998), weights = weight_pop)
nom_08  <- lm(conspc ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_24, year == 2008), weights = weight_pop)

real_87 <- lm(conspc_1987 ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_24, year == 1987), weights = weight_pop)
real_98 <- lm(conspc_1987 ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_24, year == 1998), weights = weight_pop)
real_08 <- lm(conspc_1987 ~ 0 + factor(north), data = filter(civ_24, year == 2008), weights = weight_pop)

# 3. Stack nominal (is_real = 0) and deflated (is_real = 1) consumption for the pooled model
civ_24_pooled <- bind_rows(
  civ_24 %>% mutate(is_real = 0, cons_val = conspc),
  civ_24 %>% mutate(is_real = 1, cons_val = conspc_1987)
)

pool_87 <- lm(cons_val ~ 0 + factor(north) + factor(north):is_real,
              data = filter(civ_24_pooled, year == 1987), weights = weight_pop)
pool_98 <- lm(cons_val ~ 0 + factor(north) + factor(north):is_real,
              data = filter(civ_24_pooled, year == 1998), weights = weight_pop)
pool_08 <- lm(cons_val ~ 0 + factor(north) + factor(north):is_real,
              data = filter(civ_24_pooled, year == 2008), weights = weight_pop)

# Helper to extract (After - Before) interaction terms and align row names to North / South
extract_diff <- function(mod) {
  ct <- summary(mod)$coefficients
  ct_diff <- ct[c("factor(north)1:is_real", "factor(north)0:is_real"), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(ct_diff) <- c("factor(north)1", "factor(north)0")
  class(ct_diff) <- "coeftest"
  ct_diff
}

diff_87 <- extract_diff(pool_87)
diff_98 <- extract_diff(pool_98)
diff_08 <- extract_diff(pool_08)

# 4. Present Before, After, and Difference (After - Before) in a 9-column huxreg table
tab_cons_24 <- huxreg(
  "1987" = nom_87,  "1998" = nom_98,  "2008" = nom_08,
  "1987" = real_87, "1998" = real_98, "2008" = real_08,
  "1987" = diff_87, "1998" = diff_98, "2008" = diff_08,
  coefs = c(
    "North" = "factor(north)1",
    "South" = "factor(north)0"
  ),
  error_format = "({std.error})",
  error_pos = "below",
  number_format = 2,
  statistics = c(N = "nobs"),
  stars = NULL,
  note = "Notes: Population-weighted daily per capita consumption in current CFA francs (columns 1-3), constant 1987 South PPP CFA francs (columns 4-6), and differences. Significance stars omitted since all estimates are highly significant."
) %>%
  insert_row(
    "",
    "Before Deflation", "", "",
    "After Deflation", "", "",
    "Difference (After - Before)", "", "",
    after = 0
  ) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 2:4) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 5:7) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 8:10) %>%
  set_align(1, 2:10, "center") %>%
  set_bold(1, 2:10, TRUE) %>%
  set_caption("Average Daily Per Capita Consumption Before and After CPI and PPP Deflation") %>%
  set_label("tbl-consumption_deflation")

tab_cons_24 <- set_all_padding(tab_cons_24, 1.5)
tab_cons_24
```

# Absolute Poverty Measures
**3.a**

```{r, 3_1_poor_headcount_237}
civ_87_08_cleaned <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    poor_237   = as.integer(conspc87 < 237),
    weight_pop = hhsize * weight
  )

# 1. Interaction OLS: coefficients on factor(year):north give (North - South) directly
mod_diff_237 <- lm(poor_237 ~ 0 + factor(year) + factor(year):north,
                   data = civ_87_08_cleaned,
                   weights = weight_pop)

mod_nat   <- lm(poor_237 ~ 0 + factor(year), data = civ_87_08_cleaned, weights = weight_pop)
mod_north <- lm(poor_237 ~ 0 + factor(year), data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, north == 1), weights = weight_pop)
mod_south <- lm(poor_237 ~ 0 + factor(year), data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, north == 0), weights = weight_pop)

# Extract the three North - South interaction rows and align row names to factor(year)
ct_diff <- summary(mod_diff_237)$coefficients[
  c("factor(year)1987:north", "factor(year)1998:north", "factor(year)2008:north"),
  , drop = FALSE
]
rownames(ct_diff) <- c("factor(year)1987", "factor(year)1998", "factor(year)2008")
class(ct_diff) <- "coeftest"

outreg <- huxreg(
  "National"           = mod_nat,
  "North"              = mod_north,
  "South"              = mod_south,
  "Diff (North-South)" = ct_diff,
  coefs = c(
    "1987" = "factor(year)1987",
    "1998" = "factor(year)1998",
    "2008" = "factor(year)2008"
  ),
  error_format = "({std.error})",
  error_pos = "below",
  number_format = 3,
  statistics = c(N = "nobs"),
  stars = c(`***` = 0.01, `**` = 0.05, `*` = 0.1),
  note = "Significance: {stars}"
)

outreg <-outreg %>%
  set_label("tbl-poor_headcount_237") %>%
  set_caption("Poverty Headcount Rate at 237 FCFA/day")

outreg <- set_all_padding(outreg, 1.5)

outreg
```

**3.b**

```{r, 3_2_poverty_headcount}
# 1. Create poverty indicators and population weight using unmodified conspc87
civ_87_08_cleaned <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    poor_237   = as.integer(conspc87 < 237),
    poor_474   = as.integer(conspc87 < 474),
    weight_pop = hhsize * weight
  )

# Helper to extract interaction terms and align row names to factor(year)
extract_coefs <- function(mod, terms) {
  ct <- summary(mod)$coefficients[terms, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(ct) <- c("factor(year)1987", "factor(year)1998", "factor(year)2008")
  class(ct) <- "coeftest"
  ct
}

# 2. Columns 1-3: Separate sub-sample models at 474 FCFA/day (true sub-sample N)
mod_nat_474 <- lm(poor_474 ~ 0 + factor(year),
                    data = civ_87_08_cleaned, weights = weight_pop)
mod_north_474 <- lm(poor_474 ~ 0 + factor(year),
                    data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, north == 1), weights = weight_pop)
mod_south_474 <- lm(poor_474 ~ 0 + factor(year),
                    data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, north == 0), weights = weight_pop)

# 3. Column 4: Regional difference at 474 FCFA/day (North - South)
mod_reg_diff_474 <- lm(poor_474 ~ 0 + factor(year) + factor(year):north,
                       data = civ_87_08_cleaned, weights = weight_pop)

ct_reg_diff_474 <- extract_coefs(
  mod_reg_diff_474,
  c("factor(year)1987:north", "factor(year)1998:north", "factor(year)2008:north")
)

# 4. Stack 237 and 474 FCFA indicators for Columns 5-8
civ_pooled <- bind_rows(
  civ_87_08_cleaned %>% mutate(is_474 = 0, poverty_headcount = poor_237),
  civ_87_08_cleaned %>% mutate(is_474 = 1, poverty_headcount = poor_474)
)

# Column 5: Diff (474 - 237) for National
model_pooled_national <- lm(
  poverty_headcount ~ 0 + factor(year) + factor(year):is_474,
  data = civ_pooled, weights = weight_pop
)
ct_thresh_nat <- extract_coefs(
  model_pooled_national,
  c("factor(year)1987:is_474", "factor(year)1998:is_474", "factor(year)2008:is_474")
)

# Columns 6-7: Diff (474 - 237) for North and South
model_pooled_nregion <- lm(
  poverty_headcount ~ 0 + factor(year):factor(north) + factor(year):factor(north):is_474,
  data = civ_pooled, weights = weight_pop
)
ct_thresh_north <- extract_coefs(
  model_pooled_nregion,
  c("factor(year)1987:factor(north)1:is_474",
    "factor(year)1998:factor(north)1:is_474",
    "factor(year)2008:factor(north)1:is_474")
)
ct_thresh_south <- extract_coefs(
  model_pooled_nregion,
  c("factor(year)1987:factor(north)0:is_474",
    "factor(year)1998:factor(north)0:is_474",
    "factor(year)2008:factor(north)0:is_474")
)

# Column 8: DiD (474 - 237, North vs. South)
mod_did_474 <- lm(
  poverty_headcount ~ 0 + factor(year) + factor(year):north +
    factor(year):is_474 + factor(year):north:is_474,
  data = civ_pooled, weights = weight_pop
)
ct_did_474 <- extract_coefs(
  mod_did_474,
  c("factor(year)1987:north:is_474",
    "factor(year)1998:north:is_474",
    "factor(year)2008:north:is_474")
)

# 5. Build the 3-row (years) x 8-column huxreg table with spanning group headers
pov_table_474 <- huxreg(
  "National" = mod_nat_474,
  "North" = mod_north_474,
  "South" = mod_south_474,
  "Diff (N - S)" = ct_reg_diff_474,
  "National" = ct_thresh_nat,
  "North" = ct_thresh_north,
  "South" = ct_thresh_south,
  "Diff (N - S)" = ct_did_474,
  coefs = c(
    "1987" = "factor(year)1987",
    "1998" = "factor(year)1998",
    "2008" = "factor(year)2008"
  ),
  error_format = "({std.error})",
  error_pos = "below",
  align = "c",
  number_format = 3,
  statistics = c(N = "nobs"),
  stars = c(`***` = 0.01, `**` = 0.05, `*` = 0.1),
  note = "Significance: {stars}."
) %>%
  insert_row("", "Threshold 474 FCFA/day", "", "", "", "Diff (474 - 237)", "", "", "", after = 0) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 2:5) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 6:9) %>%
  set_align(1, 2:9, "center") %>%
  set_bold(1, 2:9, TRUE) %>%
  set_bottom_border(1, 2:5, 0.4) %>%
  set_bottom_border(1, 6:9, 0.4) %>%
  set_label("tbl-poor_headcount_474") %>%
  set_caption("Poverty Headcount Rate at 474 FCFA/day and Comparison with 237 FCFA/day by Year and Region") %>%

pov_table_474 <- set_all_padding(pov_table_474, 1.5)
```

**3.c**

```{r, 3_3_poverty_headcount_uniform}
civ_87_08_cleaned <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  mutate(
    weight_pop = hhsize * weight,
    poor_237   = as.integer(conspc87 < 237)
  ) %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  mutate(
    new_cpi = first(cpi[north == 0])
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    newconspc87 = conspc / new_cpi,
    poor_new_1d = as.integer(newconspc87 < 237)
  )

# Helper to extract interaction coefficients and align row names to factor(year)
extract_coefs <- function(mod, terms) {
  ct <- summary(mod)$coefficients[terms, , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(ct) <- c("factor(year)1987", "factor(year)1998", "factor(year)2008")
  class(ct) <- "coeftest"
  ct
}

# 2. Columns 1-3: Separate sub-sample models for Q3.c (so each column displays its true N)
mod_nat_3c   <- lm(poor_new_1d ~ 0 + factor(year),
                   data = civ_87_08_cleaned, weights = weight_pop)
mod_north_3c <- lm(poor_new_1d ~ 0 + factor(year),
                   data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, north == 1), weights = weight_pop)
mod_south_3c <- lm(poor_new_1d ~ 0 + factor(year),
                   data = filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, north == 0), weights = weight_pop)

# 3. Column 4: Pooled regional model for Q3.c (North - South)
mod_reg_diff_3c <- lm(poor_new_1d ~ 0 + factor(year) + factor(year):north,
                      data = civ_87_08_cleaned, weights = weight_pop)

ct_reg_diff_3c <- extract_coefs(
  mod_reg_diff_3c,
  c("factor(year)1987:north", "factor(year)1998:north", "factor(year)2008:north")
)

# 4. Stack Q3.a (is_3c = 0) and Q3.c (is_3c = 1) to estimate differences (Q3.c - Q3.a)
civ_pooled_3c_3a <- bind_rows(
  civ_87_08_cleaned %>% mutate(is_3c = 0, poverty_headcount = poor_237),
  civ_87_08_cleaned %>% mutate(is_3c = 1, poverty_headcount = poor_new_1d)
)

# Column 5: Diff (Q3.c - Q3.a) for National
mod_diff_nat_3c_3a <- lm(
  poverty_headcount ~ 0 + factor(year) + factor(year):is_3c,
  data = civ_pooled_3c_3a, weights = weight_pop
)
ct_diff_nat_3c_3a <- extract_coefs(
  mod_diff_nat_3c_3a,
  c("factor(year)1987:is_3c", "factor(year)1998:is_3c", "factor(year)2008:is_3c")
)

# Columns 6-7: Diff (Q3.c - Q3.a) for North and South
mod_diff_reg_3c_3a <- lm(
  poverty_headcount ~ 0 + factor(year):factor(north) + factor(year):factor(north):is_3c,
  data = civ_pooled_3c_3a, weights = weight_pop
)
ct_diff_north_3c_3a <- extract_coefs(
  mod_diff_reg_3c_3a,
  c("factor(year)1987:factor(north)1:is_3c",
    "factor(year)1998:factor(north)1:is_3c",
    "factor(year)2008:factor(north)1:is_3c")
)
ct_diff_south_3c_3a <- extract_coefs(
  mod_diff_reg_3c_3a,
  c("factor(year)1987:factor(north)0:is_3c",
    "factor(year)1998:factor(north)0:is_3c",
    "factor(year)2008:factor(north)0:is_3c")
)

# Column 8: Triple-difference (North - South under Q3.c minus North - South under Q3.a)
mod_did_3c_3a <- lm(
  poverty_headcount ~ 0 + factor(year) + factor(year):north +
    factor(year):is_3c + factor(year):north:is_3c,
  data = civ_pooled_3c_3a, weights = weight_pop
)
ct_did_3c_3a <- extract_coefs(
  mod_did_3c_3a,
  c("factor(year)1987:north:is_3c",
    "factor(year)1998:north:is_3c",
    "factor(year)2008:north:is_3c")
)

# 5. Build the 3-row (years) x 8-column huxreg table
tab_pov_new <- huxreg(
  "National" = mod_nat_3c,
  "North" = mod_north_3c,
  "South" = mod_south_3c,
  "Diff (N - S)" = ct_reg_diff_3c,
  "National" = ct_diff_nat_3c_3a,
  "North" = ct_diff_north_3c_3a,
  "South" = ct_diff_south_3c_3a,
  coefs = c(
    "1987" = "factor(year)1987",
    "1998" = "factor(year)1998",
    "2008" = "factor(year)2008"
  ),
  error_format = "({std.error})",
  error_pos = "below",
  align = "c",
  number_format = 3,
  statistics = c(N = "nobs"),
  stars = c(`***` = 0.01, `**` = 0.05, `*` = 0.1),
  note = "Significance: {stars}."
) %>%
  insert_row("", "Uniform CPI & PPP = 1", "", "", "", "Diff (Q3.c - Q3.a)", "", "", after = 0) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 2:5) %>%
  merge_cells(1, 6:8) %>%
  set_align(1, 2:8, "center") %>%
```

# Growth Incidence Curves 
**4.d**

```{r}
set.seed(123)
B <- 500 # Number of bootstrap replications (use 500–1000 for final report)
probs_grid <- seq(0.01, 0.99, by = 0.01)

# 1. Point estimates from the actual sample
civ_87_08_cleaned <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  mutate(weight_pop = hhsize * weight)

gic_point <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  reframe(
    percentile = 1:99,
    y = as.numeric(quantile(ewcdf(conspc87, weights = weight_pop), probs = probs_grid))
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = year, values_from = y, names_prefix = "y_") %>%
  mutate(
    g_87_98 = ((y_1998 / y_1987)^(1 / 11) - 1) * 100,
    g_98_08 = ((y_2008 / y_1998)^(1 / 10) - 1) * 100
  ) %>%
  select(percentile, g_87_98, g_98_08) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(g_87_98, g_98_08),
    names_to = "period",
    values_to = "estimate"
  )

# 2. Split data by year for fast stratified household bootstrap
data_87 <- filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, year == 1987)
data_98 <- filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, year == 1998)
data_08 <- filter(civ_87_08_cleaned, year == 2008)

boot_one <- function(b) {
  idx_87 <- sample.int(nrow(data_87), replace = TRUE)
  idx_98 <- sample.int(nrow(data_98), replace = TRUE)
  idx_08 <- sample.int(nrow(data_08), replace = TRUE)

  q_87 <- as.numeric(quantile(ewcdf(data_87$conspc87[idx_87], weights = data_87$weight_pop[idx_87]), probs = probs_grid))
  q_98 <- as.numeric(quantile(ewcdf(data_98$conspc87[idx_98], weights = data_98$weight_pop[idx_98]), probs = probs_grid))
  q_08 <- as.numeric(quantile(ewcdf(data_08$conspc87[idx_08], weights = data_08$weight_pop[idx_08]), probs = probs_grid))

  tibble(
    percentile = 1:99,
    g_87_98 = ((q_98 / q_87)^(1 / 11) - 1) * 100,
    g_98_08 = ((q_08 / q_98)^(1 / 10) - 1) * 100
  )
}

boot_results <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(B), boot_one)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(g_87_98, g_98_08), names_to = "period", values_to = "g_boot") %>%
  group_by(period, percentile) %>%
  summarise(
    ci_low  = quantile(g_boot, 0.025),
    ci_high = quantile(g_boot, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Merge point estimates with 95% CIs and plot
gic_ci_df <- gic_point %>%
  left_join(boot_results, by = c("period", "percentile")) %>%
  mutate(
    period = recode(
      period,
      "g_87_98" = "1987–1998",
      "g_98_08" = "1998–2008"
    )
  )

ggplot(gic_ci_df, aes(x = percentile, y = estimate, color = period, fill = period)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high, show.legend = FALSE), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(linetype = period), linetype = "solid", linewidth = 0.9) +
  labs(
    title = "Growth Incidence Curves with 95% CI",
    subtitle = "National consumption per capita in 1987 PPP FCFA",
    x = "Consumption Percentile",
    y = "CAGR (%)",
    color = "Period",
    fill = "Period",
    linetype = "Period"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# Lorenz Curves
**5.a** 
```{r, 5_lorenz_curves}
#| label: fig-lorenz
#| fig-cap: "Lorenz Curves of Daily Per Capita Consumption by Region (1987–2008)"
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| out-width: "100%"

# 1. Prepare data: stack Côte d'Ivoire (National), North, and South with population weights
civ_lorenz_base <- civ_87_08_cleaned %>%
  mutate(weight_pop = hhsize * weight)

lorenz_input <- bind_rows(
  civ_lorenz_base %>% mutate(region = "National"),
  civ_lorenz_base %>% filter(north == 1) %>% mutate(region = "North"),
  civ_lorenz_base %>% filter(north == 0) %>% mutate(region = "South")
)

# 2. Compute exact empirical Lorenz coordinates and interpolate onto percentiles 0..100
p_grid <- seq(0, 1, by = 0.01) # 0% to 100% in 1-percentile steps

lorenz_df <- lorenz_input %>%
  group_by(region, year) %>%
  arrange(conspc87, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Hint 4 & 5: Weighted empirical CDF gives cumulative population share p_i
    F_ecdf = list(ewcdf(conspc87, weights = weight_pop)),
    p_i    = F_ecdf[[1]](conspc87),
    # Hint 6: Cumulative share of total real consumption up to household i
    l_i    = cumsum(weight_pop * conspc87) / sum(weight_pop * conspc87)
  ) %>%
  reframe(
    percentile = 0:100,
    p          = p_grid,
    # Piecewise-linear interpolation anchored at (0, 0) and (1, 1)
    l_p        = approx(
      x      = c(0, p_i, 1),
      y      = c(0, l_i, 1),
      xout   = p_grid,
      ties   = "ordered"
    )$y
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    year   = factor(year),
    region = factor(region, levels = c("National", "North", "South"))
  )

# 3. Plot all three regions in one faceted figure with a single shared legend
ggplot(lorenz_df, aes(x = percentile, y = l_p * 100, color = year, linetype = year)) +
  geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "grey45", linetype = "dotted", linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~ region, ncol = 3) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20), expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20), expand = c(0.01, 0.01)) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(
    x        = "Cumulative Population Share (%)",
    y        = "Cumulative Consumption Share (%)",
    color    = "Year",
    linetype = "Year"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.title     = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.key.width = unit(1.2, "cm"),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    panel.spacing    = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.margin      = margin(5, 5, 5, 5)
  )
```
